fills.researcher_notes: Dawn, 'Commercial supply of gas from Gurguri field begins', published Feb 20 2005: 'Commercial supply of natural gas from Gurguri oil and gas fields in Karak district has been started through 78 kilometre-long 10 inch-diameter pipeline to Kohat and other parts of the country.' This is an exact spec match to the sheet's own LengthKnown=78.0 and Diameter=10 for this row, which is strong corroboration that this article IS this pipeline (not just a nearby project), and 'has been started' as of the Feb 2005 publication supports StartYear1=2005. Second Dawn piece, 'DERA ISMAIL KHAN: Six districts of NWFP to get supply of gas' (Sept 10 2004, dawn.com/news/370096), gives the project's origin: gas discovered at Gurguri (Dec 2002 per a third source below), with an 'experimental 70km pipeline' to Kohat as phase one, ahead of a larger 312km distribution build-out costed at Rs1.85bn. The 70km-vs-78km gap is consistent with a planning-stage estimate vs as-built length, not a different pipeline. A third outlet, energynewsbulletin.net ('Sui Northern to build Gurguri-Kohat pipeline'), independently names the same project and gives the Dec-2002 discovery date, but its page 403'd on direct fetch/verification, so I have NOT included it as a proposed_ref -- it is corroborating color only. tier=medium rather than high because both cited refs are the same outlet (Dawn) on different dates: the Sept-2004 piece confirms the project's existence/plan but does not itself state a completion year, so the actual date claim rests on the single Feb-2005 article, not two independent confirmations of that specific fact. Both URLs verified OK via scripts/url_verifier.py (200 + expected content present).
